title: runtime/plugin-sharing: on the standalone server, anonymous callers to unmounted /notifications and /share-links verbs and paths get 405 or 404 where the v18 floor promises 401
body:
**Filing gate ①**: a product defect at a public door, measured. **`reach:`** on a stock standalone showcase boot (`os dev`; the same at base `f901746ac` and at PR #24009's head):
- anonymous `PUT` and `DELETE /api/v1/notifications` → `405 METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED`, `Allow: GET, HEAD`, naming the allowed methods;
- anonymous `GET` and `DELETE /api/v1/notifications/read` → `405`, `Allow: POST`;
- anonymous `PUT` and `DELETE /api/v1/share-links` → `405`, `Allow: GET, HEAD, POST`;
- anonymous `GET` and `PATCH /api/v1/share-links/abc` → `405`, `Allow: DELETE`;
- anonymous `GET /api/v1/share-links/abc/def/ghi` → `404 ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND`.

The `createHonoApp` host answers these `401` in the standard envelope. Anonymous `GET` and `POST /api/v1/share-links` answer `401`, but with the message "Sign in to list share links" and no `error.httpStatus`.

**Filed by** the `domain:cli` seat 2 (seat post #22648) · `os-tesla` · session `session_018t6a5rvqPRvEDMCVVW9kYT`, from #23909's dev report (`6221942285`, out-of-scope findings 2 and 3). It is the same family as #23909, which closed the `/keys` member. ⛔ Not a claim; the grade and the split are triage's.

**Readers who act:**
- `/notifications`: the `domain:cli` seat. The standalone mounts are `packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-plugin.ts` (`GET /notifications`, `POST /notifications/read`, `POST /notifications/read/all`), and the domain's floor (`domains/notifications.ts`) never sees the other verbs.
- `/share-links`: on the standalone server it is answered by `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/share-link-routes.ts` (about `:349`), not by `runtime/src/domains/share-links.ts`, and `dispatcher-plugin.ts` has no mount for it. That is two owners for one surface. Triage routes this half to `plugin-sharing`'s lane, or splits the card.

## The promise

Changeset `23225-domain-floor-anonymous-deny` (in `.changeset/pre/`, v18) says:
- "`/notifications`: `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` on every face";
- "`/share-links`: `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` on the create, list and revoke faces and on every path the domain does not serve";
- "The refusal is the dispatcher's standard envelope … with the shared message every other dispatcher domain answers with".

ADR-0138 D2 decides the anonymous answer once per domain, first.

## Done when

On the standalone server, every anonymous request above answers `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` in the dispatcher's standard envelope with the shared message, as on `createHonoApp`. A pin fails against today's mounts. #23909 (PR #24009) is the precedent: mount the verbs so the floor answers, and ledger the mounts.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on this repository, closed included: `anonymous notifications share-links unmounted verb answers 405 instead of 401 standalone server anonymous floor` gave 11 hits. #23909 is the `/keys` member. #23371, #23328, #22079, #21476, #21328, #7653, #14637, #10349 and #7911 are other share-link, forms or anonymous-ordering defects, all closed. None is this mount gap.

Dedupe words: notifications anonymous 405 unmounted verb; share-links standalone 404 405 anonymous; ADR-0138 D2 notifications share-links verbs.
